1 - 2 Beds at The Lofts on Neil
2/2 also available. 1 bedroom from $1,540/mo (price reduced from $1,590).
Located 6 min by bike to campus. Washer/dryer in every unit, stainless dishwasher, underground garage $110/mo.
Landlord pays water; tenant pays electric about $70 and internet.
Pets: maybe, ask. Deposit $300 - $600 depending on credit. Fee: $185 monthly valet trash and amenity.
Utilities: Typical bills for the unit about $140; resident pays electric, gas.
